input: Reseal the driveway before the rainy season

gold.taskTitle: Reseal Driveway Before Rainy Season Starts
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reseal their driveway in preparation for the upcoming rainy season.

questions.title: What material is your driveway made of?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is asphalt, concrete, pavers, or another material determines the type of sealant and method required.

questions.title: When does the rainy season typically begin in your area?
questions.description: Establishing the deadline helps set a realistic timeline for completing all preparation and sealing work.

questions.title: How long ago was the driveway last sealed?
questions.description: The time since the last seal affects how much prep work, cleaning, or crack repair will be needed before resealing.

questions.title: Are there existing cracks or damage that need repair first?
questions.description: Visible damage may require patching or filling before a sealant can be properly applied.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire a contractor?
questions.description: Whether this is a DIY project or a hired job changes the plan entirely, from tool sourcing to scheduling.

questions.title: What is the approximate size of your driveway?
questions.description: The square footage determines how much sealant to purchase and how long the job will realistically take.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for this project?
questions.description: A budget helps guide decisions on sealant quality, tool rental or purchase, and whether to hire professional help.
